name: Nutrients through food
description: Animals carry nutrient. Eating fills a store (a little of every plant, most of every piece of meat), the rest becomes dung, and some of the store is lost as dung wherever the animal walks. A baby's body is built from its parent's store, not the soil, and a well-fed parent gives its baby a bigger start. An animal short of nutrient pays extra upkeep. Color the dots by Nutrient store and watch the readout: in this world nutrient, not energy, decides who can breed, and meat (rich in nutrient) becomes far more worth hunting.
